title: 第9章
content_zh:
贺图南不明白一向很有风度，一向讲究体面的一个人，为什么出现在这里？又为什么和这么一群不堪的人纠缠？
那个漂亮的女孩子，此刻，已经变成耻辱的一部分，贺图南为自己先前所有所有的念头和行为感到后悔。
她在听到奶奶那句话时，震惊，恐惧，她想，那不会是真的，尽管在这之前有些东西影影绰绰发了芽，但没机会成长，她有非常强大的信念否定它。
现在，她也混乱了，她谁也不想见，可偏偏，贺叔叔在这里，苏老师在这里，妈妈都不在了，一个已经死去的人还要蒙羞，又或者，不是蒙羞该怎么办？
因为贺以诚的缘故，村头聚了好些人，探头探脑，不知在说些什么，展颜望过去，看着那些蠕动的嘴，不知怎的，每个人的嘴型都像在说“搞破鞋”，这让人无法呼吸，连空气，都被“搞破鞋”霸占了。
她其实并不太懂这三个字是怎么回事，但她知道，有些词注定本身就是脏的，可耻的。
“展颜？展颜？”苏老师拍拍她肩膀，她脸色极难看，老师喊了好几声，才听见。
他把面粉放进了贺以诚车子的后备箱，这是贺以诚提议的，准备去学校谈。
门口的几个女人嘴里还在喊着“有庆娘”，爷爷不知什么时候出来的，坐门口，闷头抽着烟袋，展有庆像是丢了魂，爷俩坐到了一块儿，只剩女人们在那儿，说的说，骂的骂。
展颜浑浑噩噩坐在了苏老师车后座上，若是平时，她一定很不好意思，可现在，她忘记了不好意思，只是垂着头，一言不发。
贺图南在副驾驶上，父子都没说话，气氛沉闷，他扭头看看窗外，正好能瞧见摩托车上的展颜。
原来，她个头并不矮，腿很修长，可人真够单薄的，头发被春风肆意吹着，贺图南疑心她在哭。
贺以诚似乎觉得没什么跟儿子解释的，只是说：“颜颜过得非常不好，你看看这里，这么凋敝，她吃了很多苦。”
贺图南没再说话，他皱着眉，窗外一畦畦土地绿意盎然，油菜花正在盛时，偶尔有赶毛驴车的迎面而来，又有放羊的慢吞吞过去。
镇上的学校是个两层教学楼，校门口，边上牌子写着“米岭镇中心校”几个大字。
进去后，右手边是几排教职工宿舍，有的老师，一家几口都挤在里头，单身的住着则又宽敞几分。
“展颜，你跟这个……”苏老师不知道怎么称呼贺图南，含糊过去，“你们在屋里坐会儿，我跟贺先生在学校里走走。”
贺图南从车里拿了瓶健力宝，倒不拘束，往苏老师家的小马扎上一坐，喝了几口，便把瓶子放在脚边。
展颜知道他是贺叔叔的儿子了，也知道，方才那尴尬丢人的一幕，贺图南全看见了，青春期少女的那种羞赧和自尊心，在她和他独处的这刻，又剧烈地发酵起来。
贺图南的目光再次流动，她整个人，笼在斜射的阳光里，有种毛茸茸的质感，人是纤弱文静的，可五官秾丽，唯有嘴巴天生嘟起，平添几分稚气纯真。

她妈妈一定很漂亮，所以，才能迷惑男人，贺图南想到这觉得非常倒胃口，他宁愿自己今天压根没来这一趟。
content_en:
He Tunan didn't understand why a man who had always been very graceful and dignified appeared here. And why are you entangled with such a group of unbearable people?
That beautiful girl had become a part of shame at this moment. He Tunan regretted all his previous thoughts and actions.
When she heard her grandma's words, she was shocked and frightened. She thought that it couldn't be true. Although something had sprouted vaguely before, it had no chance to grow. She had a very strong belief to deny it.
Now, she is also confused. She doesn't want to see anyone, but unfortunately, Uncle He is here, Teacher Su is here, and her mother is gone. A dead person still has to be humiliated, or what should I do if he is not humiliated?
Because of He Yicheng, many people gathered at the end of the village. They looked around, wondering what they were talking about. They looked over and looked at the squirming mouths. For some reason, everyone's mouth shape seemed to be saying "break the shoes". This made people unable to breathe, and even the air was occupied by "break the shoes".
She actually didn't quite understand what these three words were, but she knew that some words were destined to be dirty and shameful.
"Showing your face? Showing your face?" Teacher Su patted her on the shoulder. She looked extremely ugly. The teacher shouted several times before she heard her.
He put the flour into the trunk of He Yicheng's car. This was He Yicheng's suggestion and he was going to talk to the school.
Several women at the door were still shouting "Mother Youqing". Grandpa came out at some time and sat at the door, smoking his pipe. Zhan Youqing seemed to have lost his soul. The two of them sat together, leaving only the women there, talking and cursing.
Zhan Yan sat in the back seat of Teacher Su's car in a daze. Normally, she would have been very embarrassed, but now, she forgot her embarrassment and just lowered her head without saying a word.
He Tunan was in the passenger seat. Neither father nor son spoke. The atmosphere was dull. He turned his head and looked out the window, just in time to see Zhan Yan on the motorcycle.
It turned out that she was not short and had slender legs, but she was really thin. Her hair was blowing wantonly in the spring breeze. He Tunan suspected that she was crying.
He Yicheng seemed to feel that there was nothing to explain to his son, so he just said: "Yanyan's life is very bad. Look at this place. It's so poor. She has suffered a lot."
He Tunan didn't speak anymore, he frowned. Outside the window, there was a stretch of land full of green. The rapeseed flowers were in full bloom. Occasionally, there were people driving donkey carts coming towards them, and there were sheepherders slowly passing by.
The school in the town is a two-story teaching building. At the school entrance, there is a sign with the words "Miling Town Central School" written on it.
After entering, there are several rows of staff dormitories on the right hand side. Some teachers and their families are crowded in, but the dormitories for singles are a bit more spacious.
"Zhanyan, you and this..." Teacher Su didn't know what to call He Tunan and mumbled, "You guys sit in the room for a while, Mr. He and I will walk around the school."
He Tunan took a bottle of Jianlibao from the car, and he didn't feel restrained. He sat on Teacher Su's pony, took a few sips, and put the bottle at his feet.
Zhanyan knew that he was Uncle He's son, and also knew that He Tunan had witnessed the embarrassing and embarrassing scene just now. The shyness and self-esteem of an adolescent girl fermented violently again when she was alone with him.
He Tunan's eyes moved again. Her whole body, enveloped in the slanting sunlight, had a furry texture. She was delicate and quiet, but her facial features were beautiful. Only her mouth was naturally pouted, which added a bit of childishness and innocence.
Her mother must be very beautiful, so she can confuse men. He Tunan felt very off-putting when he thought of this. He would rather he didn't come here at all today.
